nodes.name: Get Order Details
nodes.notes: Fetches full order details from Medusa Admin API including line items, product IDs, and quantities.

nodes.name: Update Medusa Stock
nodes.notes: Marks the product as 'draft' (out of stock) in Medusa and adds sold metadata. This cascades to the frontend.

nodes.name: Update Inventory DB
nodes.notes: OPTIONAL: Calls the InvStorage frontend API to mark the inventory item as sold. Enable this after creating the /api/sales/sync-sold endpoint.

nodes.name: eBay IPN Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives eBay Instant Payment Notification (IPN) when an item sells. Configure this URL in eBay Developer Portal.

nodes.name: Parse eBay Sale
nodes.notes: Parses eBay IPN. Enable when you have eBay API credentials configured.

nodes.name: Find Medusa Product by eBay ID
nodes.notes: Looks up the Medusa product that has this eBay Item ID in its metadata.

main.node: Find Medusa Product by eBay ID
